decisions.reason: The same-message MODIFY already captures that all location sites share one layout template; no additional state change or stale attribute is present.
The existing message 42 MODIFY already records reuse of the website structure with location-specific branding and wording.
The candidate's same-message INTRODUCE already records that packages and prices remain consistent across location websites.
Location-specific branding and shared site structure do not change which legacy content, images, or booking information must be reused.
The source decision does not change Harbor Valley site availability or master-site linkage during the transition.
Shared structure and location-specific branding do not alter how visitors discover locations or are routed from the master site.
The source message does not change the master website domain or any domain-routing configuration.
The branding and template clarification does not modify the established SEO-preservation goal or migration handling.
The message describes reuse of structure across multiple websites and does not replace or modify the separate-website-per-location model.
Shared packages, prices, and layout do not change the requirement for separate location payment setups and payouts.
Reusing a common site structure does not change the established requirement that each location have its own Wix account.
The source decision concerns presentation consistency and does not alter separate revenue, sales, or reporting tracking for each location.
